contract: Durable screen and presentation admission precede live-host visibility; visibility precedes release of renderer effects and shown. A retired host cannot reveal, and Activity recreation retries visibility without replaying durable admission. Closing while no live frame exists rejects old waiting effects.

rendererRetirement.contract: Retiring a native host releases its reveal-waiting effects as harmless no-ops, rejects effects queued behind an in-flight durable publication, and allows that admitted publication to drain. Replacement hosts retain logical admission and emission sequencing.
